transcript:
Header: 2026-11-24 15:30 PST, duration ~52m. Attendees listed.
[00:00] Maya: Hey everyone thanks for hopping on, quick audio check.
[00:06] Rita: Loud and clear.
[00:10] Maya: Goal is a tight walkthrough of the Console around route-level usage and cost, and a look at Optimize for batching/caching. Daniel will demo.
[00:21] Daniel: Opening the Console home, default lens last 7 days, pivot by route or model. Left nav shows route explorer.
[00:30] Daniel: Here we have routes you mentioned - ingest-normalize, clinical-summarize, user-chat. You can pin, tag, and attach billing codes.
[00:45] Dana: Can billing codes map to our internal chargeback IDs?
[00:49] Daniel: Yes, custom billing fields supported and included in CSV export.
[00:56] Rita: Token-level cost - per route or only by model?
[01:02] Daniel: Both. Per-route breakdown shows prompt vs completion tokens and unit cost accounting for model variant and quantization.
[01:18] Marcus: How does prefix cache affect effective token counts? Can we simulate?
[01:27] Daniel: In Optimize there's a cache-savings estimator. Input hit rate and it projects token savings and dollar impact.
[01:36] Daniel: Example - 40% prefix cache hit rate reduces token spend by ~28% in this sample and shows p95 latency improvement.
[01:49] Dana: Does that include batching?
[01:52] Daniel: The estimator uses current batching profile by default. Toggle batching and change batch size to see combined effect. Console overlays p95 and p99 latency.
[02:07] Rita: Can we export p95/p99 per route?
[02:13] Daniel: Yes, Route Insights panel exports CSV with p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, token counts, and cost per call.
[02:22] Marcus: Are metrics from control plane or node-level traces?
[02:28] Daniel: We ingest request telemetry from runtimes and support trace hooks. Console aggregates for UI, raw traces available for download.
[02:40] Dana: Audit logs granularity? Need to show auditor who accessed what at route level.
[02:46] Maya: Audit logs include user-level entries for Console actions and API key usage; raw logs can be routed to SIEM. SSO and SCIM supported.
[02:58] Rita: KMS for customer-managed keys - supported?
[03:06] Daniel: Supported in Private deployments and Dedicated enterprise add-on. We attach KMS keys and log key usage.
[03:14] Maya: Per-route ledger view - compute vs memory vs storage and token vs fixed overhead. Drill to model-version token consumption.
[03:26] Daniel: Notice spike on Nov 18 for clinical-summarize; clicking spike shows sample requests and top prompt lengths.
[03:36] Rita: Clinical route has long contexts; can we cap context or apply cost guard?
[03:41] Daniel: Yes, per-route policies can enforce max context, fallbacks to cheaper variants, and down-sampling of long prompts.
[03:51] Marcus: Can Console show combined billing when using Dedicated for prod and Hosted for dev?
[03:58] Daniel: Yes, multi-deployment rollups label usage by deployment and allow combined or filtered views.
[04:08] Dana: Forecasting what-if for 10% growth on chat?
[04:12] Daniel: Cost simulator adjusts baseline traffic per route and reruns model, recommending Optimize knobs like batch size changes or quantized variants.
[04:24] Rita: Any customer examples of cost reduction?
[04:27] Maya: Customer cut per-token spend ~30% after enabling prefix caching and moving background routes to q4 quantized models; we can share the case study.
[04:36] Marcus: Data residency - can telemetry remain in EU?
[04:41] Daniel: Yes, for Private and Dedicated we restrict storage region and retention; Console will surface logs only from allowed regions when residency flag enabled.
[04:51] Rita: On rollouts, can we compare old and new model versions for quality and cost?
[04:57] Daniel: Rollout comparison view shows token cost, latency, and simple eval on holdout prompts and shows spend delta for rollback.
[05:07] Maya: Recap - Daniel export per-route CSV, Maya send pricing and security docs, Rita send sample traces. Target pilot kickoff week of Dec 6.
[05:19] Rita: Sounds good.
[05:21] Dana: FinOps ok with timeline.
[05:23] Marcus: Will loop infra for pilot network planning.
[05:31] End recording.
Notes: occasional transcription errors (kv cache transcribed as kv cash in spots), some speaker overlap. Shared links: demo deck https://redwood.app/decks/citrine-console and sample cost model spreadsheet (to be emailed).
